capabilities.name: Let an agent see your accounts and start payments through your bank
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent read your bank accounts and start payments through regulated open banking APIs?

US.note: The CFPB finalised its Section 1033 data rights rule, but a court stayed its compliance dates in October 2025 and the CFPB is reworking it, so there is no regulated access yet. Aggregators like Plaid connect apps to banks outside a mandated regime.

evidence.title: Personal financial data rights
Section 1033
Plaid: Enabling all companies to build fintech solutions

GB.note: The CMA9 open banking mandate gives licensed apps account data and payment initiation, and platforms such as TrueLayer and Plaid connect apps to it. The UK Payments Initiative launched its commercial Variable Recurring Payments scheme in June 2026, starting with a first wave of lower-risk sectors only.

evidence.title: Commercial VRP & UKPI
Open banking takes next step forward with launch of UK Payments Initiative scheme
UK Payments Initiative: UK banks and fintechs launch new payment scheme
TrueLayer - Europe's leading open banking platform
Plaid: Enabling all companies to build fintech solutions

DE.note: EU PSD2, applied in Germany through the ZAG, makes banks give licensed account information and payment initiation providers API access. BaFin licenses these providers, and platforms such as Tink and TrueLayer serve German banks. There is no standard for recurring variable payments yet.

evidence.title: Geschäfte der Zahlungsinstitute, E-Geld-Institute & Kontoinformationsdienste
Revised rules for payment services in the EU (PSD2 summary)
Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2): Directive 2015/2366/EU
Buhl erhält BaFin-Erlaubnis für Kontoinformationsdienste und Zahlungsauslösedienste
Tink I Europäische Open-Banking-Plattform
TrueLayer - Europe's leading open banking platform

BR.note: Open Finance Brasil, run by the Banco Central, is mandatory for large institutions and lets licensed payment initiators (ITPs) start Pix, Pix Automático and no-redirect (JSR) payments, and IN BCB 746 removes the fixed R$500 cap on JSR payments from 1 October 2026. Connectors such as Belvo and Pluggy plug apps into it.

evidence.title: Open Finance
Instrução Normativa BCB nº 746, de 16 de junho de 2026
evidence.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil (Diário Oficial da União, copy hosted by Poder360)

evidence.title: Belvo rolls out Pix Automático
Pluggy · Infraestrutura de Open Finance para o Brasil

MX.note: Article 76 of the 2018 Fintech Law mandates open APIs, but only open-data (and credit bureau) rules exist; the CNBV and Banxico have still not issued the rules for account and transaction data, so there is no regulated access yet. Aggregators like Belvo connect apps to banks outside a mandated regime.

evidence.title: Ley para Regular las Instituciones de Tecnología Financiera (Article 76)
evidence.publisher: Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores

evidence.title: Open Finance en México: entre la regulación y la implementación
Banca abierta en Mexico | Regulaciones y Estado
Actualidad en la normatividad fintech en México
Belvo | The leading open finance data and payments platform in Latin America

CL.note: Ley Fintec 21.521 created the CMF Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas (NCG 514, technical standards in NCG 569 of June 2026), but the CMF pushed its start from July 2026 to July 2027, so it is not live yet. Until then, firms like Fintoc connect bank accounts and start transfers outside a regulated regime.

evidence.title: CMF modifica la normativa que regula el Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas e incorpora anexo técnico
CMF modifica la NCG N°514 e incorpora estándares técnicos para la implementación del Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas
CMF pone en consulta modificación a la NCG N°514 del Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas
Welcome (Fintoc developer docs)

CO.note: A voluntary open finance scheme (Decree 1297 of 2022, Superfinanciera Circular 004 of 2024) is in place, and Decree 368 of April 2026 makes it mandatory, but the SFC has not yet set the mandatory rules and timeline.

evidence.title: SFC trabaja en hitos requeridos para implementar modelo de finanzas abiertas obligatorias
Decreto 368 de 2026
La SFC expide regulación sobre las finanzas abiertas en Colombia

IN.note: The RBI Account Aggregator framework, with Sahamati as its industry body, lets apps read your accounts with consent (over 500 million consents by September 2026). NPCI's UPI lets third-party apps start payments for you, and Setu offers APIs for both.

evidence.title: Ecosystem Map
Account Aggregator crosses 500 million consents as India marks 5th AA Foundation Day
UPI product overview
Setu — UPI Payments, KYC & Credit Infrastructure APIs

ES.note: EU PSD2, applied in Spain through Real Decreto-ley 19/2018, makes banks give licensed account information and payment initiation providers API access, under Banco de España supervision. Open banking platforms such as Tink serve Spain. There is no standard for recurring variable payments yet.

evidence.title: Real Decreto-ley 19/2018, de servicios de pago (PSD2 in Spain: payment initiation and account information services; article 45 refunds unauthorised payments)
Revised rules for payment services in the EU (PSD2 summary)
Tink: plataforma europea de open banking (España)

FR.note: EU PSD2, written into the French Code monétaire et financier, makes banks give licensed account information and payment initiation providers API access. The ACPR licenses these providers, such as Powens (CIB 16948), and platforms such as Tink and TrueLayer also serve French banks. There is no standard for recurring variable payments yet.

evidence.title: Revised rules for payment services in the EU (PSD2 summary)
Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2): Directive 2015/2366/EU
Powens: open finance platform (authorized and regulated by the ACPR, CIB 16948)

CA.note: The Consumer-Driven Banking Act makes the Bank of Canada the supervisor of open banking, but the regime has not started: the proposed regulations were published in the Canada Gazette on 27 June 2026, and on 2 November 2026 the Bank was still consulting on its accreditation guidelines. No launch date for account access or payment initiation is set.

evidence.title: Consumer-driven banking

JP.note: Since June 2018 the Banking Act lets firms registered as electronic payment agency service providers (電子決済等代行業者) read account balances and history and pass transfer instructions to banks for you, under contracts with each bank. Banks open these APIs voluntarily, and far fewer offer payment (update) APIs than read-only ones, so payment initiation is patchy.

evidence.title: 平成30年6月から「電子決済等代行業」に関する新しい制度がはじまりました
電子決済等代行業者の登録完了のお知らせ (reference and update APIs)

AU.note: Consumer Data Right open banking has let accredited apps read bank data since 2020, but only read-only. Payment initiation is law since August 2024, but no action type has been declared, so no regulated API lets an agent start a payment yet.

evidence.title: Action initiated? Action initiation under Australia's Consumer Data Right becomes law
Where next for the Consumer Data Right?

NG.note: The CBN issued an open banking framework in 2021 and operational guidelines in 2023, with NIBSS running the registry, but the go-live slipped from August 2025: in October 2025 a CBN official said it was not live, and in June 2026 the rollout was still described as a phased go-live through mid-2026. Aggregators such as Mono connect apps to bank accounts outside the regulated regime. One trade site says the framework went live in August 2025, so the sources conflict.

evidence.title: Operational Guidelines for Open Banking in Nigeria
Circular on the Regulatory Framework on Open Banking in Nigeria
Nigeria's open banking still in the works
As Nigeria prepares for the open banking rollout

KR.note: AI services can already read account data with consent through MyData, such as Hana Bank's MyData-based AI financial advice from March 2026. Agents starting payments through open banking is still a proof of concept, and industry speakers in May 2026 said the rules for agent-made payments are not yet set.

evidence.title: Hana Bank Launches Customized Financial Consultation Service Combining MyData and AI
'Buy my 200,000-won sneakers when they drop to 170,000 won': Inside Naver Pay's AI agent payment push
“네이버·카카오·토스 기술력은 충분한데” AI가 사람 대신 결제, 한국서 늦어지는 이유는? [크립토360]

SG.note: We found no open banking rule in Singapore that lets third parties read your bank accounts or start payments through regulated APIs. A 2016 push to open bank APIs only encouraged firms and set no timeframe, and our search found no 2026 rule that changes this.

evidence.title: Singapore moves to promote open APIs in banking as fintech push gathers pace

ID.note: Indonesia's SNAP open API standard, set by Bank Indonesia, is in force. Banks and payment providers have to adopt it, and non-bank firms can join to serve their own customers, with customer consent and Bank Indonesia approval. We found no consumer app or AI agent that reads bank balances or starts payments through it yet.

evidence.title: PADG 23/15/PADG/2021 on SNAP, the national open payment API standard
Open banking in Indonesia (SNAP) tracker

IT.note: Italy's PSD2 law (Legislative Decree 218/2017) makes account information and payment initiation licensed services, so licensed providers can read accounts and start payments. CBI Globe, an Italian open finance ecosystem, says its standard APIs follow PSD2 and that a licensed third party can reach all Italian current accounts. We did not find a named AI agent product that uses these APIs yet.

evidence.title: Decreto Legislativo 15 dicembre 2017, n. 218
CBI Globe
Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (PSD2)

NL.note: PSD2 is EU law that applies in the Netherlands, and it requires banks to let licensed third parties read account data and start payments with the customer's consent. ABN AMRO's developer portal lists a live PSD2 payment initiation API, so a licensed third party can start payments from an ABN AMRO account.

evidence.title: Summary: revised rules for payment services in the EU (PSD2)
ABN AMRO Developer Portal

AE.note: The UAE Open Finance Regulation is issued and banks are rolling it out. ADIB says it has rolled out open finance on Central Bank-certified APIs, and Pay10 went live in April 2025 for payment initiation, including variable recurring payments. I found no bank or app that lets an AI agent read accounts or start payments, and the later rollout phases have no date.

evidence.title: ADIB rolls out open finance under UAE Central Bank framework
Pay10 first to launch on UAE's regulated open finance infrastructure
UAE unveils open finance regulation to boost digital financial services

SA.note: Saudi open banking is only starting. SAMA began licensing open banking providers on 26 March 2026, Lean Technologies was the first licensed firm, and Tatbiq Darahem Co. for Technology Almaliya was later approved for account information. Partners such as Tamara use Lean's data, but I found no consumer app that lets an AI agent read accounts or start payments.

evidence.title: SAMA Commences Licensing of Fintech Companies to Provide Open Banking Services
Lean Technologies becomes the first licensed company to provide open banking services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Saudi finance licenses climb to 74 as payment providers hit 32
SAMA introduces Licensing Framework for open banking providers

ZA.note: South Africa has no open finance rule in force. The FSCA's 2026 to 2029 Regulation Plan names open finance as a priority, but the work is still at policy development, so there is no rule that lets an agent use bank data or start payments. A third-party tracker gives a January 2026 start date that the FSCA plan does not support, so confidence is low.

evidence.title: The FSCA has published its three-year Regulation Plan for the period 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2029

KE.note: Kenya has no open finance access in force yet. A draft National Payment System Bill, 2026, from Treasury and the Central Bank of Kenya would make banks and M-PESA share customer data with licensed third parties, but only with the customer's consent. The bill still needs Parliament, and the Central Bank's rules on access, data and fees come later.

evidence.title: New Bill forces banks, M-Pesa to share customer data
Central Bank of Kenya releases plan to implement open banking

AR.note: Decree 353/2025 created Argentina's open finance system (Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas) and names the central bank, BCRA, as its enforcing authority. The BCRA has not yet published the technical standards or timeline, so no bank or app can yet let an AI agent read accounts or start payments. The first use the BCRA described was credit, with lenders reading income data.

evidence.title: BCRA lanzó Open Finance: un sistema que cambiará el acceso a los créditos
Open finance tracker: Argentina

capabilities.name: Ask your bank's assistant to send money or pay bills
capabilities.question: Can a bank's own AI assistant send money or pay bills for you by chat or voice?

US.note: Bank of America's Erica can send and request money with Zelle and schedule bill payments inside the mobile app.

evidence.title: Erica, your virtual financial assistant

GB.note: Zopa's AI assistant, Ask, sends money, requests payments and pays invoices from a photo, by voice or chat, for its Biscuit current account customers (launched September 2026). Starling Assistant (March 2026) sets up savings transfers and organises bill payments for personal customers who opt in. Revolut's AIR freezes cards and buys eSIMs, and NatWest Cora handles questions and fraud claims. Lloyds said its agentic assistant would carry out payment requests, but in October 2026 we found no sign it had reached all customers, and we found no Monzo assistant that moves money.

evidence.title: Zopa unveils UK's most helpful banking AI
Zopa AI
Starling launches agentic AI assistant
Lloyds Banking to launch AI-powered financial assistant
UK's Lloyds puts testing at the heart of AI rollout
Revolut enters new era of money intelligence with launch of AI assistant
Being a trusted partner for tomorrow's banking through technology

DE.note: Commerzbank's Ava can block cards, check balances and order products, but we found no sign it makes transfers, Sparkasse chat channels say they do not accept transfer orders, and bunq describes its Finn assistant (December 2025 upgrade) as support and information only. In October 2026 N26's press room listed no AI assistant, ING's virtual assistant in its app only answers questions, and searches found nothing for Deutsche Bank beyond an old Siri transfer feature. Searches for DKB's AI support assistant showed only customer service, with no sign of transfers. We kept the flag because no bank page rules out a launch we missed.

evidence.title: Commerzbank launches AI-based Banking Avatar
bunq launches smarter, more powerful upgrade to GenAI financial assistant
Sicherheitshinweise Beraterchat

Press

BR.note: Nubank's AI sends Pix from a text, photo or voice message in the app and on WhatsApp (WhatsApp capped at R$800 per transfer). Bradesco's BIA makes Pix transfers and pays bills by voice or text in its app and by text on WhatsApp, and Itaú's ia.i also does transactions by chat.

evidence.title: Pix com Inteligência Artificial agora no App e WhatsApp do Nu
Itaú Unibanco lança ia.i, nova experiência conversacional
Como falar com a BIA e como ela pode te ajudar

MX.note: BBVA México's Blue assistant makes transfers, pays credit cards and sets up cardless withdrawals from a typed or spoken command, with a password check before each one.

evidence.title: Blue es el asistente virtual de la app BBVA
Cuatro funcionalidades de Blue para facilitar la vida de los clientes

CL.note: Itaú Chile launched voice and text transfers to third parties in its app in June 2026, where an AI agent fills in the transfer and the user confirms with Itaú Pass. We count it as limited because only news reports describe it and no Itaú page confirms that all customers have it. In October 2026 we found no similar feature at BancoEstado, Banco de Chile, BCI or Santander Chile.

evidence.title: Itaú Chile lanza Transferencias por Voz y da un paso hacia la banca conversacional
Itaú lanza funcionalidad para hacer transferencias usando la voz en su app

CO.note: Davivienda's DaviPlata wallet let users who signed up with a QR code move money by voice or AI chat in a first phase from June 2024, but we could not confirm it is open to all users today. The payments app Tpaga (not a bank) launched a WhatsApp AI agent in July 2026 that pays utility bills and sends Bre-B transfers. Bancolombia's Tabot only answers questions, and we found no assistant that moves money at Nequi.

evidence.title: En DaviPlata ahora podrá manejar su dinero con la voz
Tpaga lanzó el primer agente de inteligencia artificial en Colombia para pagar por PSE (the article covers bill payments and Bre-B transfers)
Tabot asistente virtual

IN.note: News reports say Indian Bank's AI-TARA voice assistant (unveiled September 2026) does fund transfers and IMPS in 10 languages, but the bank's own investor deck only calls it a voice AI relationship manager and does not say all customers have it. NPCI's Hello! UPI voice payments roll out in phases, and Axis Bank's new branch kiosk (September 2026) has an AI assistant that fills in forms for services like utility bill payments. SBI's YONO Ji assistant answers questions for YONO Business users, and we found no assistant that moves money at HDFC or ICICI.

evidence.title: Indian Bank debuts AI-TARA voice banking in 10 languages at Global Fintech Fest 2026
Performance Analysis Q2/H1 FY27
Axis Bank and Hitachi Payment Services unveil AI-powered solutions for smarter banking and merchant payment experiences
AI-powered conversational payments to launch on India's UPI

ES.note: BBVA's Blue assistant in the Spanish app sends Bizum payments from a typed or spoken request (over 400,000 in 2022), and since February 2025 its generative AI version also carries out common account and card operations for all customers. CaixaBank's AI agents and its ChatGPT app (October 2026) only inform and guide product sign-ups, with no money movement.

evidence.title: Bizum (pídele un Bizum a Blue por voz o texto)
Blue, el asistente virtual de BBVA, incrementa los pagos por Bizum un 17% en 2022
For the first time in Spain, BBVA will offer AI-powered account and card management with its virtual assistant
CaixaBank deploys its app on the ChatGPT marketplace

FR.note: Sumeria (formerly Lydia) has offered SIA, a generative AI assistant in its app, since February 2026; it can prepare a transfer and act on your accounts. Revolut's AIR reached France in September 2026 but cannot yet prepare a transfer, and Hello bank!'s HelloïZ only points you to the right screen, with in-chat transfers planned for late 2026. Only a press article describes SIA's transfer feature.

evidence.title: SIA, l'assistant IA de Sumeria lancé en février 2026
Revolut déploie AIR, son assistant IA, en Europe
Hello bank! lance HelloïZ, assistant IA du service clients propulsé par Mistral

CA.note: CIBC's Virtual Assistant, a chat bot in CIBC Online Banking and the mobile app (English and French), sends Interac e-Transfers, pays bills and moves money between accounts. CIBC launched it as an AI assistant in 2020; its current page calls it a bot and does not describe the technology. No 2026 agent that moves money was found at RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO or Wealthsimple.

evidence.title: Introducing CIBC's Virtual Assistant
CIBC introduces AI-based Virtual Assistant

JP.note: Sumishin SBI Net Bank's NEOBANK ai agent (beta since February 2026) sends transfers to registered payees from a chat request, including several payees at once, but only for approved beta users at ten branches; a business version for some corporate customers started beta on 29 October 2026. We found no agent that moves money at the big banks (MUFG, SMBC, Mizuho).

evidence.title: NEOBANK ai エージェント(ベータ版)のベータテスト開始について
evidence.publisher: 住信SBIネット銀行 (now DOCOMO SMTB Net Bank)

evidence.title: AI銀行サービス「NEOBANK ai」エージェントのベータテストを開始

AU.note: CommBank Companion is in testing with staff and select business customers (May 2026) and does not move money; Macquarie's Q (January 2026) answers questions; CBA's older Ceba bot helps with payments but no source says it sends them itself. No Westpac, NAB or ANZ assistant that pays was found.

evidence.title: Reimagining banking with CommBank Companion
Macquarie reimagines customer-focused banking with launch of Q
Commonwealth Bank introduces chatbot that can answer 200 banking and payments questions

NG.note: UBA's Leo, which UBA calls an AI chat banking assistant, lets customers send money, buy airtime and data and pay bills inside WhatsApp, Messenger and Apple Messages for Business (number +234 903 001 0007). Leo dates from 2017 and works mostly as a guided chatbot, not a generative AI agent. We found no assistant that moves money at Moniepoint, OPay, Kuda or PalmPay; Moniepoint's "M" chatbot only answers questions.

evidence.title: Chat with Leo - UBA Nigeria
Leo Is Live on WhatsApp!!!
Moniepoint AI chatbot for Nigeria's informal economy
4 years on, UBA's Leo continues to lead the pack in Nigeria, Africa

KR.note: KakaoBank's AI transfer (launched November 2025) lets any deposit account holder send money by chat or voice, up to 2 million won per transfer and per day. The customer must still confirm and verify the final step, and K Bank's similar AI transfer from July 2026 works the same way. No similar feature was found at Kookmin, Shinhan, Woori or Toss Bank.

evidence.title: “엄마한테 5만원 보내줘”…카카오뱅크, ‘AI이체’ 출시

SG.note: DBS says some features of its Joy assistant, which now use generative and agentic AI, let customers finish a banking task in the chat. The article does not name those tasks, so we could not confirm that Joy sends money or pays bills. OCBC's assistant is described only for portfolio questions, and we found no UOB assistant that moves money.

evidence.title: How DBS, OCBC and UOB are betting on AI in 2026

ID.note: We found no Indonesian bank whose AI assistant moves money by chat or voice. Mandiri's MITA assistant on WhatsApp answers questions, and a 2020 report said its transaction services were still being built. We did not find a 2026 source showing that changed.

evidence.title: Bank Mandiri permudah transaksi lewat asisten virtual di WhatsApp

IT.note: We found no Italian bank whose AI assistant moves money, pays bills or takes payment orders by chat or voice. A January 2026 Milano Finanza review of bank AI covers UniCredit's lending and deal tools and Intesa Sanpaolo's fraud tools, and neither moves money for customers.

evidence.title: L'AI cresce in banca

NL.note: I found no Dutch bank assistant that moves money for customers. bunq's Finn is described as an AI support assistant, and ABN AMRO's chatbot Anna answers questions. Coverage is thin, so confidence is low.

evidence.title: bunq launches smarter, more powerful upgrade to GenAI financial assistant

AE.note: ADCB unveiled a new app on 11 May 2026 with an AI assistant that takes voice or text commands. The launch coverage says it can check balances, move money, manage cards and track goals, but it does not say all customers have it or that it pays bills. I found no UAE bank assistant that pays bills.

evidence.title: ADCB puts AI at mobile banking core
ADCB unveils to customers its unrivalled mobile banking application

SA.note: I found no Saudi bank whose AI assistant sends money or pays bills. Searches for Al Rajhi, SNB, Alinma and STC Bank found no such assistant, and Bank AlBilad's AI plans cover corporate cash management. One result describes a Noura-branded assistant for plain-language account tasks, but the bank is unnamed and I could not confirm it moves money.

evidence.title: Bank AlBilad partners with Intellect Design Arena on the eMACH.ai platform

ZA.note: No South African bank's AI assistant sends money or pays bills yet. Absa's Abby, live on its app and website, is confined to customer support, questions and navigation, and we found no 2026 report of FNB, Standard Bank, Nedbank or Capitec launching an assistant that moves money.

evidence.title: Absa deepens AI push with renewed Salesforce partnership

KE.note: Equity's EVA chatbot, on WhatsApp, Messenger and Telegram, could send money and pay bills at its 2022 launch, and it was described as AI-driven. Current availability was not confirmed, and I could not open the bank's own pages.

evidence.title: Equity virtual assistant chat banking platform

AR.note: Banco Macro's MacroChat, launched in August 2026, takes text, voice or photo requests on WhatsApp for transfers to the customer's own accounts and to third parties, bill payments and phone top-ups, with a handoff to a human agent. Launch reach is unclear, so we rate it limited. We found no money-moving assistant at Galicia, Santander, BBVA or Naranja X.

evidence.title: Banco Macro lanzó MacroChat

repos.name: Firefly III
repos.role: Self-hosted personal finance manager with a REST API, so an agent can read and record your bank transactions.

repos.name: Firefly III Data Importer
repos.role: Pulls bank transactions into Firefly III through third-party open banking providers or bank files.

repos.name: Sure
repos.role: Self-hosted personal finance app, the community fork of Maybe, that syncs bank accounts through Plaid and other providers and has a built-in AI assistant.

repos.name: Qonto MCP Server
repos.role: Qonto's official MCP server that lets an agent read account balances and transactions of a French business bank account at Qonto.

repos.name: Powens Webview JS
repos.role: Official web component from Powens, the French open banking aggregator, that lets a person link their bank accounts so an app can read balances and transactions.

repos.name: Consumer Data Standards
repos.role: The official Consumer Data Right (CDR) API standards from Australia's Data Standards Body, which define how an accredited app or agent reads bank accounts, balances and transactions in Australia.

repos.name: CDR Mock Data Recipient
repos.role: The ACCC's mock Consumer Data Right data recipient, so a developer can build and test an app or agent that gets consent and reads Australian bank data before going live.

repos.name: Fiskil CDR toolkit
repos.role: Go library from Fiskil for accredited data recipients to call Australian Consumer Data Right bank APIs, including mTLS setup and the CDR register.

repos.name: Fiskil Link
repos.role: Fiskil's hosted consent screen SDK, where an Australian user grants an app or agent access to their bank data through the Consumer Data Right.

repos.name: Up Banking API
repos.role: Open API spec for Up, an Australian digital bank, that lets a customer's own app or agent read accounts and transactions and get webhooks with a personal token.

repos.name: Mono Node library
repos.role: Official Node.js client for Mono, a Nigerian open banking API, to read linked bank accounts, balances, transactions and identity, and start direct bank payments.

repos.name: Mono Connect.js
repos.role: Official Mono widget that lets a person link their Nigerian bank account to an app, so the app or agent can then read it through Mono's API.
